openaiBaseUrl.title: OpenAI / Compatible base URL
openaiBaseUrl.description: API base URL ending before /chat/completions and /audio/speech (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, https://api.deepseek.com/v1, or http://localhost:11434/v1). Configure the API key in Settings -> Plugins -> Secrets.

openaiModel.title: OpenAI model
openaiModel.description: Model identifier sent to the chat completions endpoint.

openaiStructuredDict.title: Structured dictionary mode for short phrases
openaiStructuredDict.description: Ask the LLM for phonetics, parts of speech, definitions, and example sentences on words and short phrases.

openaiSystemPrompt.title: Custom system prompt
openaiSystemPrompt.description: Optional extra system prompt instructions appended for OpenAI-compatible translation.

openaiTranslatePrompt.title: Text prompt template (Velocity-style)
openaiTranslatePrompt.description: Optional full prompt template supporting [SYSTEM], [USER], #if($SOURCE_LANGUAGE)...#else...#end, ${SOURCE_LANGUAGE}, ${TARGET_LANGUAGE}, ${TEXT}, and ${DS}. Leave blank to use the built-in translator/dictionary prompt.

openaiDocumentPrompt.title: Document prompt template (Velocity-style)
openaiDocumentPrompt.description: Optional Velocity-style prompt template used when translating documents, comments, or Markdown.

deeplTier.title: DeepL API tier
deeplTier.description: DeepL endpoint tier. Store your DeepL Auth Key in Settings -> Plugins -> Secrets (deepl-api-key).

deeplCustomUrl.title: DeepL custom endpoint URL
deeplCustomUrl.description: Full /v2/translate URL used only when DeepL API tier is set to custom.

deeplFormality.title: DeepL formality
deeplFormality.description: Tone preference for supported DeepL target languages (DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, PL, PT-BR, PT-PT, JA, RU).

microsoftMode.title: Microsoft Translator mode
microsoftMode.description: edge-free uses Microsoft Edge translator tokens (no key required); azure uses your official Azure Cognitive Services secret (microsoft-api-key).

microsoftRegion.title: Azure Translator region
microsoftRegion.description: Optional Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region header for multi-service Azure resources (leave global if unsure).

microsoftCustomEndpoint.title: Microsoft custom endpoint
microsoftCustomEndpoint.description: Optional custom base URL for Azure Translator.

googleMode.title: Google Translate mode
googleMode.description: free uses translate.googleapis.com with rich dictionary entries; cloud-api uses Google Cloud Translation v2 with google-api-key secret.

googleCustomHost.title: Google custom host (optional)
googleCustomHost.description: Optional custom Google Translate host (e.g. translate.google.com) used when net:ask is granted.

googleUseSpellCheck.title: Spell check & alternate translations
googleUseSpellCheck.description: Request Google spelling suggestions (Did you mean...?) and alternate translation variants (&dt=at).

youdaoAppKey.title: Youdao App Key
youdaoAppKey.description: Youdao Zhiyun App ID for openapi.youdao.com/api (v3 signed requests).

youdaoAppSecret.title: Youdao App Secret
youdaoAppSecret.description: Youdao App Secret used solely to compute local SHA-256 v3 signatures; never transmitted or shown in UI.

baiduAppId.title: Baidu App ID
baiduAppId.description: Baidu Fanyi API App ID for fanyi-api.baidu.com.

baiduSecretKey.title: Baidu Secret Key
baiduSecretKey.description: Baidu Secret Key used solely to compute local MD5 request signatures; never transmitted or shown in UI.

alibabaAccessKeyId.title: Alibaba AccessKey ID
alibabaAccessKeyId.description: Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID for Machine Translation (TranslateGeneral).

alibabaAccessKeySecret.title: Alibaba AccessKey Secret
alibabaAccessKeySecret.description: Alibaba Cloud AccessKey Secret used solely to compute local HMAC-SHA1 RPC signatures; never transmitted or shown in UI.

alibabaRegionId.title: Alibaba Region ID
alibabaRegionId.description: Alibaba Cloud MT region endpoint (e.g. cn-hangzhou).
